clip_overview: In an outdoor training facility shaded by trees, a mason works on a low rat-trap bond brick wall. In the first portion, he bends over to scoop cement mortar from a metal pan and spread it smoothly across the top of the bricks laid on edge. Later, after an off-camera exchange clarifying that this work is for training and a brief brick delivery by an assistant, he stands up and uses his trowel to chip and dress a red clay brick.

summary_card_lines: OVERVIEW: Skilled mason spreads mortar on rat-trap bond brick-on-edge course and later trims a brick with a trowel in an outdoor training yard.
SOURCE SPECS: 1920x1080, 50.0 fps, 19.20s (960 frames), 16:9, Rec.709, static camera on tripod.
SPEAKER & AUDIO STATUS: Mode 3 Pure Visual Infill; source speech in Tamil at 07.4-13.5s muted in edit; SUB_C0120_01 has clean nat sound; SUB_C0120_03 has clean trowel-strike nat sound from 16.8s.
SCRIPT BEAT MATCHES: Primary fits for BEAT_22, BEAT_23 (mortar spreading on course), BEAT_24, BEAT_26 (leveling workmanship), and BEAT_17, BEAT_27 (brick dressing).
CONTINUITY & STAGE: Stage_2_Laying_Bricks_on_Edge (SUB_01, SUB_02) and Stage_3_Junctions_Lintels_and_Pointing (SUB_03); landmarks include rat-trap wall, trowel, mortar pan, wooden plank.
MARKETING & MOOD: Tags PROCESS / QUALITY; Mood Calm instructional documentary tone with Industrial percussive elements.
VISUAL FLOW of the best sub-clip: Static MWS, eye-level, entry Bottom_Center to exit Bottom_Center, kinetic score 4/10, slow-motion eligible (50 fps conform), safe text zone Top_Left.
AUDIO / SFX PLAN: Nat sound trowel scraping (0.0-7.2s) and brick chipping (16.8-19.2s); Foley cues for wet mortar spreading and sharp ceramic trowel strikes on A3.
PAIRING & NOTES: Use SUB_C0120_01 as primary B-roll for mortar laying; SUB_C0120_02 is mutually exclusive with SUB_01; SUB_C0120_03 serves as detail insert of brick cutting.
